notes.title: v0.6.0 - Puzzle Park Update!
notes.content:
Get ready for a new batch of mind bending puzzles!

[h1]Features:[/h1]
- Added a new blockset for a nice park asthetic
- Added 2 new types of gimmick blocks (and 2 new levels using them)
- Added version text to the main menu (so you know what version you play)

[h1]Level's:[/h1]
- Added 6 new puzzle levels
- Added a new HUB world (Puzzle Park)

[h1]Bugfixing:[/h1]
- Fixed a bug regarding the audio speed when loading a new song (the music was too slow)
- Improved level part spawning logic to prevent strange behaviour
- Fixed collider interaction between light source collider and other collider types
- Changed rotation calculation logic to prevent any wrong rotations or crashing
- Other minor bugfixing

Got any ideas or want to talk to the developer about PARADOGX?

notes.title: v0.5.0 - Language Support & More
notes.content:
A BIG milestone for PARADOGX is now live!

[h1]Features:[/h1]
- Added multi language support. The following languages are fully implemented:
Chinese Traditional
Chinese Simplified
Korean
Japanese
German
Polish
Turkish
Some more languages are in the game but not yet properly tested, If you want to help with translation and get featured in the credits, join the discord!

- The UI got a rework with new features
You can now show levels you already finished
You can now reset your save file in the UI
A new Audio UI was added

- Rhythm blocks will now listen to the music rhythm in puzzle mode to blend both modes more into each other
This will change the gameplay a lot in puzzle mode

[h1]Features:[/h1]
- Improved block meshes for better performance

[h1]Bugfixing:[/h1]
- Fixed a random crash regarding Options loading
- Fixed a saving and loading bug when launching the game
- Fixed minor gameplay issues

notes.title: v0.4.0 - Changes and Improvements
notes.content:
Sorry for taking so long!
I'v got sick but the update is now finally out <3

All in all it's a needed update and helps having less issues while playing.
I also moved things around based on feedback. The Rhythm Section of the game is now moved a little bit away from the first 15 Minuts playtime of the game.

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- Changed the Main HUB world because it got confused as a level
- Added more a sign with a description in HUB worlds (Rhythm Mazeand Main HUB)
- Improved performance with engine update
- Move trail got a little update and is ready for skin system
- Improved MoveBlocks performance and behaviour A LOT
- The level "Whirly Wind" is now easier to beat

[h1]New Shortcut[/h1]
While holding CTRL + SHIFT
[Type a number on your Numblock between 1 and 53]
Release CTRL + SHIFT

[h2]If you want to reset your savefile do the following:
[/h2]Press CTRL + SHIFT + D

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
- Score & HighScore Leaderboards
- A content pack with new blocks

[h1]The PARADOGX Discord is now live!
[/h1]

notes.title: PARADOGX Version 0.2.0 - Trailblazing Tricks and 6 NEW levels!

I'm thrilled to bring you Version 0.2.0, packed with exciting new features and essential improvements. I have been hard at work to improve the game, and I can't wait for you to dive into the latest update. With a new moveset addition, the WallSmash move, and even more levels!

[*] Added trails to moving objects and player

notes.title: PARADOGX version 0.1.0
notes.content:
**🐾 Version 0.1.0 Update is Here! 🐾**

After a lot of back and forth between playtesters and working on the feedback, version 0.1.0 is ready and in good shape! We've fetched all the best ideas and now it's pawsitively fantastic!

[h2]Feature List:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Saving and Loading Game Data - SteamCloud supported
[*] Achievements - Earn your pawsome badges!
[*] Controller and Keyboard Support - Play the way that suits your paws!
[*] Audio System - Tested on speakers most of the time
[*] MIDI System - Get the groove!
[*] Core Player Controller - More coming in the future!
[*] UI Systems - A user interface that’s a real treat!
[*] Level Loading - Fetch new levels seamlessly!
[*] 20+ Levels to Play - Plenty of ground to sniff around!
[*] 8 Adaptive Songs - Tunes that adapt to your gameplay!
[*] Bones (Very Important) - We know what you’re really after!
[*] Gimmick Blocks - Surprises at every corner!
[/list]

...and much more to keep your tails wagging!

Hope you enjoy our latest updates!
